mission: Test whether change-depth taxonomy predicts later independent consumption better than mechanism/fit features and persistence alone.
questionOrHypothesis: Are method/meta-selection changes intrinsically more compounding than state/capability/policy changes?
evidenceSelection: Frozen historical changes from Agent-first and PAL R1 with explicit initial change, later independent consumer/outcome and maintenance/retention disposition.
minimalCandidateOrNoChange: M-FIT uses future-model robustness, owner/mechanism fit, outcome observability, causal distance, transfer representation and recurring cost without assuming depth ordering.
independentOracle: Later independent consumption and canonical retain/localize/delete disposition, not self-description of the original change.
holdoutSplit: PAL P1-P5 plus at least one ACS owner surface.
invalidityConditions: change class is assigned from later outcome rather than original artifact
consumer is not independent of the proposing experiment
later availability is mistaken for useful consumption
budget: Deterministic historical analysis first; no owner mutation.
stopRule: Score frozen cases and report all disagreements/counterexamples.
deletionOrNoChangeOutcome: If depth does not outperform fit/simple baselines, keep change-depth only as descriptive vocabulary.
publicationBoundary: No Core/PAL law from F2 alone.
